items.title: GOP issues stark warning to AI companies

title_i18n.es: El Partido Republicano lanza una severa advertencia a las empresas de IA

excerpt_i18n.en: Republicans issue a stark warning to AI companies, signaling potential regulatory and policy scrutiny over data centers and election-related risks.

items.title: 'Model fatigue' sets in as AI labs race to roll out new versions

title_i18n.zh: 随着AI实验室竞相发布新版本，模型疲劳开始显现。
title_i18n.es: La «fatiga de modelos» se instala mientras los laboratorios de IA compiten por lanzar nuevas versiones.

excerpt_i18n.en: Anthropic, OpenAI, Meta and Google all released model updates this week, while Nvidia said it's acquiring open-source AI platform Hugging Face.
excerpt_i18n.zh: Anthropic、OpenAI、Meta和谷歌本周均发布了模型更新，同时英伟达宣布将收购开源AI平台Hugging Face。
excerpt_i18n.es: Anthropic, OpenAI, Meta y Google lanzaron esta semana actualizaciones de sus modelos, mientras que Nvidia anunció que está adquiriendo la plataforma de IA de código abierto Hugging Face.

items.title: The Jobs Apocalypse Is Postponed. An AI Jobs Boom Is Here
items.raw_excerpt: The Economist argues that fears of an AI-driven jobs apocalypse have not materialized, and instead an AI jobs boom is emerging. AI is seen as creating new roles and opportunities, postponing the predicted disaster.

title_i18n.en: The Jobs Apocalypse Is Postponed. An AI Jobs Boom Is Here
title_i18n.zh: 就业末日被推迟了。AI就业热潮已经到来
title_i18n.es: El apocalipsis del empleo se aplaza. Llega un auge de empleos de IA

excerpt_i18n.en: The Economist argues that fears of an AI-driven jobs apocalypse have not materialized, and instead an AI jobs boom is emerging. AI is seen as creating new roles and opportunities, postponing the predicted disaster.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 《经济学人》文章指出，此前对AI导致大规模失业的担忧并未成真，反而出现了由AI驱动的就业热潮。文章认为，AI技术正在创造新的工作岗位和产业机会，就业末日被推迟。

items.title: All About IQ. Does AI Have an IQ?
items.raw_excerpt: The article discusses whether AI can have an IQ, noting that traditional IQ tests are designed for humans and not directly applicable to AI. AI performance is typically measured through specific benchmarks, and direct comparisons to human intelligence remain problematic.

title_i18n.en: All About IQ. Does AI Have an IQ?
title_i18n.zh: 关于IQ的一切。AI有IQ吗？
title_i18n.es: Todo sobre el CI. ¿Tiene la IA un CI?

excerpt_i18n.en: The article discusses whether AI can have an IQ, noting that traditional IQ tests are designed for humans and not directly applicable to AI. AI performance is typically measured through specific benchmarks, and direct comparisons to human intelligence remain problematic.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 本文探讨了人工智能是否拥有IQ的问题。文章指出，传统IQ测试是为人类设计的，不能直接用于衡量AI能力；AI的性能通常通过特定基准测试来评估。虽然AI在某些任务上表现出色，但将其与人类智力直接比较并不恰当。

items.title: The AI Boom Is Coming for Your Gadgets

title_i18n.es: El boom de la IA viene a por tus gadgets

excerpt_i18n.en: This article examines how the AI boom is expanding into consumer gadgets, predicting wider integration of AI features in everyday devices and highlighting its potential impact on hardware makers and user experiences.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 本文探讨了人工智能热潮正逐步扩展到消费电子产品领域，预示着未来各类智能设备将更广泛地集成AI功能。文章分析了这一趋势对硬件制造商、软件生态及用户日常体验的潜在影响，并指出AI或将成为下一代消费电子产品的核心差异化因素。

items.title: Cory Doctorow on the Big AI Lie [video]

title_i18n.zh: Cory Doctorow谈AI的大谎言 [视频]
title_i18n.es: Cory Doctorow sobre la gran mentira de la IA [vídeo]

He warns the public against tech giants' exaggerated claims about AI capabilities, urging attention to power imbalances in technological development.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 这则视频中，Cory Doctorow 探讨了人工智能领域中的夸大宣传与谎言，指出当前围绕AI的叙事往往掩盖了其背后的真实风险与社会影响。他提醒公众警惕科技巨头对AI能力的过度渲染，并关注技术发展中的权力不平等问题。

items.title: Security vulnerabilities of AI data centers flagged at intelligence hearing
items.raw_excerpt: Hudson Institute senior fellow David Feith urged House Intelligence Committee members at a recent hearing to consider data centers as a major cybersecurity target for adversaries including China, as policymakers survey the threat landscape -- and the implications of artificial intelligence -- 25 years after the 9/11 attacks.

title_i18n.en: Security vulnerabilities of AI data centers flagged at intelligence hearing
title_i18n.zh: 情报听证会指出人工智能数据中心的安全漏洞。
title_i18n.es: Señalan vulnerabilidades de seguridad en los centros de datos de IA en una audiencia de inteligencia

excerpt_i18n.en: Hudson Institute senior fellow David Feith urged House Intelligence Committee members at a recent hearing to consider data centers as a major cybersecurity target for adversaries including China, as policymakers survey the threat landscape -- and the implications of artificial intelligence -- 25 years after the 9/11 attacks.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 哈德逊研究所高级研究员戴维·法伊特在近期听证会上敦促众议院情报委员会成员将数据中心视为包括中国在内的对手的主要网络安全目标，政策制定者正在审视相关风险。
